_about: A small graph with each case of the IBM tab's neighbourhood counts, counted by hand: the definition is in scripts/train/ibm_multignn/neighbourhood.py. Edge 0 (account 0 to 1, row 5,000 at 600 s, batch 2) and edge 3 (1 to 4, row 6,200, batch 3) are scored. Edge 6 repeats row 4,100, edge 7 is a self-transfer, edge 2 is later in edge 0's batch, edges 3 and 4 lie beyond it, edge 4 is two hops from edge 0 and edge 5 three.
